<title>Vanta Client</title>
<style>
:root{--bg:#080808;--panel:#101010;--panel2:#151515;--line:rgba(255,255,255,.11);--muted:#929292;--white:#f7f7f7;--ease:cubic-bezier(.2,.75,.2,1)}

span{color:#777}.manifesto-copy{color:#b0b0b0;font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.9}.stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:27px}.stat{padding-top:16px;border-top:1px .22s}.tab-button:hover{color:#fff}.tab-button[aria-selected="true"]{background:#f2f2f2;color:#090909;box-shadow:0 0 24px #ffffff12}.tab-content{min-height:275px;padding:clamp(24px,5vw,48px);display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:center;gap:30px;animation:fade .35s}.tab-content h3{font-size:clamp(28px,4vw,38px);letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:0 0 12px;font-weight:900}.tab-content p{max-width:520px;font-size:14px;color:#b5b5b5;font-weight:500;line-height:1.85;margin:0}.tab-symbol{width:120px;height:120px;border:1px solid #ffffff0a}.download{padding:30px 24px 110px}.download-card{max-width:1152px;margin:auto;text-align:center;padding:70px 24px;border:1px solid #333;border-radius:18px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 0%,#252525 0%,#101010 45%,#0a0a0a 100%);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.download-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(120deg,transparent 20%,#ffffff06 h2{font-size:clamp(42px,7vw,78px);letter-spacing:-.08em;margin:0;font-weight:950;text-shadow:0 4px 45px #ffffff16}.download-card p{font-size:13px;color:#999;line-height:1.8;max-width:440px;margin:17px 24px;text-align:left}.release-option{min-width:0;padding:17px 16px;border:1px solid #303030;border-radius:11px;background:#0b0b0b;color:#eee;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .22s,border-color .22s,background .22s,box-shadow .22s}.release-option:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#777}.release-option.selected{border-color:#f5f5f5;background:#191919;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px #ffffff20,inset 0 0 24px #ffffff06}.release-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}.release-top strong{font-size:16px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:-.03em}.release-tag{font-size:8px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.09em;color:#aaa}.release-desc{display:block;margin-top:9px;color:#898989;font-size:10px;line-height:1.5}.download-actions{margin-top:0!important}.download-actions strong{color:#f5f5f5;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:900}footer a:hover{color:#fff}.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s var(--ease),transform .7s breathe{0%,100%{transform:scale(.96);opacity:.7}50%{transform:scale(1.04);opacity:1}}@keyframes logoFloat{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}50%{transform:translateY(-9px) scale(1.035)}}@keyframes blink{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.35}}@keyframes shine{0%,65%,100%{transform:translateX(-100%)}85%{transform:translateX(100%)}}@media(max-width:760px){.brand img{width:39px;height:39px}.brand{font-size:14px}.nav-wrap{padding:13px 18px}.menu-toggle{display:block}.nav-cta{display:none}.nav-links{display:none;position:absolute;top:64px;left:15px;right:15px;flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:0;padding:8px;border:1px a:hover{background:#1b1b1b}.hero{min-height:92vh;padding-top:130px}.hero-logo{width:clamp(185px,48vw,250px);height:clamp(185px,48vw,250px);margin-top:32px}.section{padding:75px 18px}.section-head{display:block}.section-intro{margin-top:17px}.feature-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.feature{min-height:190px}.feature-icon{margin-bottom:22px}.manifesto-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:25px;padding:65px 20px}.tab-content{grid-template-columns:1fr}.tab-symbol{width:75px;height:75px;font-size:28px;border-radius:18px;grid-row:1}.download{padding:20px 15px 75px}.download-card{padding:55px 18px}footer .foot-inner{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}.reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* VANTA CLIENT: logo se při najetí myší neotáčí */
.brand:hover img,
.brand img:hover {
  transform: scale(1.12) !important;
  rotate: 0deg !important;
}
.hero-logo:hover {
  rotate: 0deg !important;

<body>
<header class="nav-wrap" id="topbar"><nav aria-label="Hlavní navigace">
<a class="brand" href="#home" aria-label="Vanta Client – domů"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt=""><span>VANTA CLIENT</span></a>
<div class="nav-links" id="navLinks"><a href="#features">Features</a><a href="#philosophy">Philosophy</a><a href="#experience">Experience</a><a href="#download">Download</a></div>
<a class="nav-cta" href="#download">Get Vanta <span>↗</span></a><button class="menu-toggle" id="menuToggle" aria-label="Otevřít navigaci" aria-expanded="false">☰</button>
</nav></header>
<main>
<section class="hero" id="home"><div class="hero-inner">
<div class="eyebrow"><span class="status-dot"></span> A new perspective on Minecraft</div>
<img class="hero-logo" src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Vanta logo">
<h1>PLAY<br><span>BEYOND.</span></h1>
<p class="hero-copy">A cleaner interface. A sharper experience. Meet the Minecraft client designed to keep things simple, smooth, and unmistakably yours.</p>
<div class="hero-actions"><a class="primary" href="#download">Explore Vanta <span>↗</span></a><a class="secondary" href="#features">Discover features <span>↓</span></a></div>
<div class="hero-note">BUILT FOR YOUR NEXT ADVENTURE · MADE TO FEEL DIFFERENT</div>
</div><div class="scroll-cue">Scroll to explore</div></section>
<section class="section" id="features"><div class="section-head reveal"><div><div class="kicker">01 — The essentials</div><h2>Less noise.<br>More Minecraft.</h2></div><p class="section-intro">Every detail has a purpose. Vanta puts clarity, control, and a considered design first.</p></div>
<div class="feature-grid">
<article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">01 / 03</span><div class="feature-icon">◈</div><h3>Clean by design</h3><p>A minimal black-and-white visual language that feels at home in every setup.</p></article>
<article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">02 / 03</span><div class="feature-icon">↗</div><h3>Your way to play</h3><p>A focused experience built around the things you care about, without unnecessary clutter.</p></article>
<article class="feature reveal"><span class="feature-number">03 / 03</span><div class="feature-icon">✳</div><h3>Details matter</h3><p>Thoughtful motion, crisp typography, and subtle interactions in every corner.</p></article>
</div></section>
<section class="manifesto" id="philosophy"><div class="manifesto-inner"><div class="reveal"><div class="kicker">02 — Our philosophy</div><h2>Nothing extra.<br><span>Nothing in the way.</span></h2></div><div class="manifesto-copy reveal">Your client should feel like part of your game, not another thing competing for attention. Vanta is shaped around a simple idea: keep the interface calm, the details intentional, and the experience yours.<div class="stats"><div class="stat"><strong>01</strong><span>Clear vision</span></div><div class="stat"><strong>∞</strong><span>Possibilities</span></div><div class="stat"><strong>100%</strong><span>Your game</span></div></div></div></div></section>
<section class="section tabs-section" id="experience"><div class="section-head reveal"><div><div class="kicker">03 — The experience</div><h2>Made to move<br>with you.</h2></div><p class="section-intro">Choose a focus and explore the principles behind the Vanta experience.</p></div>
<div class="tabs-shell reveal"><div class="tab-bar" role="tablist" aria-label="Vanta features"><button class="tab-button" role="tab" id="tab-1" aria-selected="true" aria-controls="panel" data-tab="0">Interface</button><button class="tab-button" role="tab" id="tab-2" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel" data-tab="1">Performance</button><button class="tab-button" role="tab" id="tab-3" aria-selected="false" aria-controls="panel" data-tab="2">Personalisation</button></div><div class="tab-content" id="panel" role="tabpanel" aria-labelledby="tab-1" aria-live="polite"><div><div class="kicker" id="tabKicker">01 / INTERFACE</div><h3 id="tabTitle">A place for focus.</h3><p id="tabText">A restrained visual style, considered spacing, and clear hierarchy help keep the experience comfortable. Nothing fights for your attention.</p></div><div class="tab-symbol" id="tabSymbol" aria-hidden="true">◈</div></div></div>
</section>
<section class="download" id="download"><div class="download-card reveal"><div class="kicker">VANTA CLIENT · RELEASES</div><h2>Ready when you are.</h2><p>Choose your release channel. Stable is intended for everyday play; Beta and Preview are for trying upcoming changes.</p><div class="release-options" role="group" aria-label="Release channel">
<button class="release-option selected" type="button" data-release="Stable" aria-pressed="true"><span class="release-top"><strong>Stable</strong><span class="release-tag">RECOMMENDED</span></span><span class="release-desc">Everyday play · Recommended</span></button>
<button class="release-option" type="button" data-release="Beta" aria-pressed="false"><span class="release-top"><strong>Beta</strong><span class="release-tag">TESTING</span></span><span class="release-desc">New features · May change</span></button>
<button class="release-option" type="button" data-release="Preview" aria-pressed="false"><span class="release-top"><strong>Preview</strong><span class="release-tag">EARLY ACCESS</span></span><span class="release-desc">Early builds · Experimental</span></button>
</div><div class="hero-actions download-actions"><button class="primary" id="downloadBtn" type="button"><span id="downloadLabel">Download Stable</span> <span>↓</span></button><a class="secondary" href="#features">Explore features</a></div><p class="smallprint" id="downloadStatus">Release files will be linked here when the client build is published.</p><p class="smallprint">Vanta Client is an independent fan project and is not affiliated with Mojang or Microsoft.</p></div></section>
</main>
<footer><div class="foot-inner"><div><strong>VANTA CLIENT</strong></div><div>Made for the moments that matter.</div><a href="#home">Back to top ↑</a></div></footer>
<div class="toast" id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div>
<script>
document.addEventListener('pointermove',e=>{document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--mx',e.clientX+'px');document.documentElement.style.setProperty('--my',e.clientY+'px');},{passive:true});
const topbar=document.getElementById('topbar');
const updateBar=()=>topbar.classList.toggle('scrolled',window.scrollY>18);
window.addEventListener('scroll',updateBar,{passive:true});updateBar();
const menuToggle=document.getElementById('menuToggle'),navLinks=document.getElementById('navLinks');
menuToggle.addEventListener('click',()=>{const open=navLinks.classList.toggle('open');menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded',String(open));menuToggle.textContent=open?'×':'☰';});
navLinks.querySelectorAll('a').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',()=>{navLinks.classList.remove('open');menuToggle.setAttribute('aria-expanded','false');menuToggle.textContent='☰';}));
const observer=new IntersectionObserver(entries=>entries.forEach(entry=>{if(entry.isIntersecting){entry.target.classList.add('visible');observer.unobserve(entry.target);}}),{threshold:.12});
document.querySelectorAll('.reveal').forEach(el=>observer.observe(el));
const tabData=[
{kicker:'01 / INTERFACE',title:'A place for focus.',text:'A restrained visual style, considered spacing, and clear hierarchy help keep the experience comfortable. Nothing fights for your attention.',symbol:'◈'},
{kicker:'02 / PERFORMANCE',title:'Keep things fluid.',text:'A good experience should feel responsive. Vanta’s design language celebrates clarity and flow, so the interface stays out of your way while you play.',symbol:'↯'},
{kicker:'03 / PERSONALISATION',title:'Make it yours.',text:'Your setup is personal. The Vanta vision is built around a flexible, considered experience that can feel right for the way you like to play.',symbol:'✳'}
];
const tabButtons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.tab-button')];
tabButtons.forEach((button,index)=>{button.addEventListener('click',()=>{tabButtons.forEach((b,i)=>{b.setAttribute('aria-selected',String(i===index));b.tabIndex=i===index?0:-1;});const panel=document.getElementById('panel');panel.style.animation='none';void panel.offsetWidth;panel.style.animation='';const d=tabData[index];document.getElementById('tabKicker').textContent=d.kicker;document.getElementById('tabTitle').textContent=d.title;document.getElementById('tabText').textContent=d.text;document.getElementById('tabSymbol').textContent=d.symbol;panel.setAttribute('aria-labelledby',button.id);});button.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{if(e.key==='ArrowRight'||e.key==='ArrowLeft'){e.preventDefault();const next=(index+(e.key==='ArrowRight'?1:-1)+tabButtons.length)%tabButtons.length;tabButtons[next].focus();tabButtons[next].click();}});});
let toastTimer;let selectedRelease='Stable';const releaseButtons=[...document.querySelectorAll('.release-option')];const downloadLabel=document.getElementById('downloadLabel');const downloadStatus=document.getElementById('downloadStatus');releaseButtons.forEach(button=>button.addEventListener('click',()=>{selectedRelease=button.dataset.release;releaseButtons.forEach(option=>{const selected=option===button;option.classList.toggle('selected',selected);option.setAttribute('aria-pressed',String(selected));});downloadLabel.textContent='Download '+selectedRelease;downloadStatus.textContent=selectedRelease+' release selected. The download link will be available when this build is published.';}));document.getElementById('downloadBtn').addEventListener('click',()=>{const toast=document.getElementById('toast');toast.textContent=selectedRelease+' download is not linked yet.';toast.classList.add('show');clearTimeout(toastTimer);toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('show'),2800);});
document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(a=>a.addEventListener('click',e=>{const target=document.querySelector(a.getAttribute('href'));if(target){e.preventDefault();target.scrollIntoView({behavior:matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches?'auto':'smooth'});}}));
</script>
</body></html>
